metadata.description: Course agent skills for product, UX, UI, architecture, implementation, debug, quality, and security.

plugins.name: cursor-skill-foundation
plugins.description: Create or improve Cursor-ready skills, rules, and expertises for a project.

plugins.name: debug-fix-agent
plugins.description: Debug a failing feature from evidence, isolate the cause, and apply the smallest safe fix.

plugins.name: dev-composer-agent
plugins.description: Implement a feature in small, testable slices across data, services, UI, and tests.

plugins.name: product-prd-agent
plugins.description: Turn a rough product idea into a usable PRD with scope, flows, and acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: quality-gate-agent
plugins.description: Run a merge-ready quality gate that combines code review, QA, and a targeted test.

plugins.name: security-review-agent
plugins.description: Review a feature for practical security risks before it is ready to ship.

plugins.name: tech-lead-architecture-agent
plugins.description: Translate a PRD into technical decisions, boundaries, and implementation slices.

plugins.name: ui-design-systems-agent
plugins.description: Turn UX flows into a UI plan with components, tokens, states, and accessibility.

plugins.name: ux-user-flow-agent
plugins.description: Design user journeys, screen logic, and state handoffs before visual UI work.
